flagged.title: Reproduction, Meiosis and DNA
flagged.reason: At 03:29 the narration erroneously states that 'mitosis shuffles the deck' instead of meiosis, which teaches an exam-penalised misconception about which cell division creates genetic variation.

mark_affecting.video_says: Put simply, mitosis shuffles the deck, mitosis just makes exact copies.
mark_affecting.lesson_says: Both start with DNA replication, but meiosis shuffles genetic material, creating variation.

flagged.title: Trophic Levels and Transfer of Biomass
flagged.reason: The video repeats the erroneous figure from F17 (stating humans receive only 10-20 kJ directly from 100 kJ of grain compared to 10 kJ through a cow), undermining the core concept and numbers of trophic energy transfer.

mark_affecting.quote: If you start with 100 kJ of energy in grain, and you eat the grain directly, you get about 10 to 20 kJ of that energy. But, if you feed that exact same grain to a cow, and then eat the cow, only about 10 kJ actually reaches you.
